name: 三界神话v2.578b版
english_name: Myth of the Three Realms (Test Zone 2)
english_description: The third build in the "Myth of the Three Realms" series (see also sjsh, the Baoji-station original, and sjshv150, the Wisteria branch) — content for a "Test Zone 2" server. Unlike its Wisteria-branch sibling, this build's site daemon allows local loopback connections unconditionally, giving it a smoother out-of-the-box registration experience.
